text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I have a track reserved
for
afternoon practice, but there's
suddenly an
unforeseen downpour.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, Big Brother! It's raining cats and
dogs!
Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Look, Big Sister! It's raining cats and
dogs!
Woohoo!
choice_data_list_en: Y-you look really happy, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted me to train on a
soft track,
right?
choice_data_list_en: Y-you look really happy, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted me to train on a
soft track,
right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So I thought if I wished for sunny
weather... it
would probably rain instead!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I hung up tons of sunshine dolls in my
room and
wished for it to be sunny every
day!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And now, look at the weather! At this
rate, the
track will be soft by the
afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While it's hard to say if this is really
something to
celebrate, Rice's happiness
makes it easy to
overlook.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the rain from this morning has dried
up! The
track is firm again!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I guess I should have known better than
to expect
things to work out my way...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a
rock! At this
rate...

text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm is plummeting like a
rock! At this
rate...

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Now?!

text_block_list.text: R-right!

text_block_list.text: Um... R-raaain! FAAALL!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Really? I-I never shout like this. It's
honestly a
little embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but it's kinda fun too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to do voice training on the
empty
track by screaming at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's exhausting, but at least it keeps Rice
Shower's
spirits high.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Take advantage of the sunshine? What
do you
mean?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-is it really okay to change our plans?

Let's study firm tracks inside and out!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're right, though... The track does look perfect.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look on... the bright side...
